@bakedchaos @MandakiniGahlot @a2zstocks @Nidhi @nehadixit123 Listening to each other, however utopic and impossible it sounds (cue john lennon's imagine!), is the only way forward for a longterm solution. The #metoo movement, which dangerously borders on being a witchhunt, can just be the starting point and not the solution.

In this furore of unbridled anger that is #metoo let's not forget that falling in love, kissing, consensual sex are all wonderful things.
The magic ingredient is consent.
You remove that, and the experience quickly descends into horror.
